title: scSTAMP-seq (2025 preprint implementation)
scope: Describe the general source-defined assay from the stated starting specimen through the molecular readout and its decoding. Preserve source-described alternative assay implementations and their prerequisites without merging them into one execution. Include necessary preparation, controls, information attribution and delegated procedural dependencies; distinguish method construction from characterization experiments and biological applications.
variant: bioRxiv version 1, posted 2025-10-02; DOI 10.1101/2025.10.01.679703. The later Nature Biotechnology publication is a distinct version and is not an extraction source for this attempt.

evidence.quote: scSTAMP-seq utilizes photocleavable hashtag oligonucleotides (PHOs) that incorporate into cell membranes to optically embed positional information onto cells using spatially patterned light before a sample is dissociated and subjected to single-cell sequencing (Fig. 1a).

unresolved.description: The primary delegates endogenous plate and multiomic Illumina-library construction to scMAT (primary p00043/p00045). Registered scMAT p00045/p00051 further delegate IVT/post-IVT conversion to scAba-seq/scMspJI-seq protocols 6,7, which are not registered packet sources. T7-IVT, enrichment, RT and final Illumina-library boundaries are supported, but their full internal recipe and genomic adapter details are not. Nonblocking for a qualified general architecture with declared delegation; no executable complete library recipe or specific uninspected fragmentation/adapter mechanism is asserted.

unresolved.description: Primary droplet Methods p00044 place amplification before the 0.6x PHO/endogenous split, whereas Supplementary Figure 10 continuation p00019 places the split before amplification. Both refer to the adapted droplet library; MULTI-seq p00228 reports after-amplification separation but cannot establish the intended scSTAMP order. The exact timing remains unknown. This is nonblocking for the frozen general-assay scope: droplet_amp_partition preserves both descriptions at a qualified composite boundary, and the primary identifies the retained spatial and endogenous fractions and their respective Illumina-library continuations. An unqualified single exact timing/interface claim would remain unsupported; no stage equivalence or reconciled execution is asserted.
